notes.title: Bubble Wrap Playtest Out Now :)
notes.notes:
Bubble Wrap beta playtest is released!
This is a fun and relaxing anti-stress game where you pop virtual Bubble Wrap. And it never runs out :D

Just click the Request Access button. Players will be randomly chosen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780082/ebdee5fda19733ae51be97602ee7a54a0f5aa244.png[/img]

Email me your feedback: [url=mailto:contact@donutask.com]contact@donutask.com[/url]. Or just comment

[b]Please note[/b]: This is an unfinished version of the game. There will still be bugs, and the final product may change. Steam Workshop features are disabled currently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780082/bece70a47e85c69b52b24a094b1a144b0e95844f.png[/img]

Enjoy! 🔵
